items.title: OpenSec 披露 Linux 内核 NFS 服务器 9.8 分漏洞，无需登录即可获取 root
items.title_zh: OpenSec 披露 Linux 内核 NFS 服务器 9.8 分预认证漏洞
items.title_en: CVE-2026-99362: Pre-Auth Linux nfsd Flaw Allows Unauthenticated Root
items.summary: OpenSec disclosed CVE-2026-99362, a CVSS 9.8 pre-auth heap overflow in the Linux kernel NFS server that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain root and affects systems since Linux 3.16.

items.title: Credit card skimming scripts using WebRTC found on popular shopping sites
items.title_zh: 黑色星期五前，基于 WebRTC 的盗卡脚本入侵五家知名购物网站
items.title_en: WebRTC-Based Card Skimmer Hits Five Popular Shopping Sites Before Black Friday
items.summary: Credit card skimming scripts abusing WebRTC were found on popular shopping sites, highlighting risks in third-party script inclusion and e-commerce security.
